I highly recommend for cat grooming.
I was very wary bringing Puss as I was sure she would create havoc and I would simply return home however the grooming session was fully completed successfully!! I am absolutely thrilled with this service and would  totally recommend.   Very confident grooming and I left with a lot of new tips and information!  Top class service!⭐️⭐️⭐️

Dublin Dog Grooming is absolutely brilliant! Carol and her team always do a fantastic job on my two dogs, Alfie and Lola,  they come home looking gorgeous and so well cared for every time. You can really see the skill and passion that goes into their work and it’s no surprise that Carol also runs an award winning grooming school. Everyone there is friendly, professional and clearly loves dogs and cats ❤️I wouldn’t go anywhere else, highly recommend! 🐶✂️

Absolutely pleasure to bring my mainecoon for grooming knowing that he will be looked after and will be provided with the top care and attentiveness. The owner is amazing lady who received numerous awards, she cares what she does and main thing she loves it! Would recommend to anyone, always so helpful! I wish all success in future!
Great service, my cat found the experience pretty stress free which is excellent!

We’ve been bringing our dogs to Carol for over 15 years now I think and couldn’t recommend her enough! My dog loves her and her and the staff are so good to my elderly dog. I know he’s in good hands with them.
